action.objective: Commit the verified reserve move Bd2, retreating the bishop from c5-pawn pressure while keeping activity; then develop rooks and hold the center.
action.rationale: Broad depth-1 search suggested f4d2 (146, exact) and single-candidate verification at depth 4 confirmed it: score 107 exact, PV f4d2 c6e5 b5d7 d8d7, no immediate mating reply, tactical refutation not_found. Only f4d2 is commit_ready. b5d7 in the PV trades the light bishop for Black's dark bishop, a reasonable structural swap. The shallower a2a3 (144) is not comparable at its depth 1 and is unverified; I keep the deeper exact evidence. Minor uncertainty: quiet threats and longer mates unexplored, but the move is safe against mate-in-one.
